standard_prerequisites.name: Theories RCA_0, the schemes T_n and the well-foundedness statements
standard_prerequisites.statement: RCA_0 is the base theory of reverse mathematics, T_n is either collection or induction for Sigma^0_n formulas, and WF of an ordinal states that the ordinal is well founded; the notation WF(omega_k^alpha) refers to the ordinal omega with subscript k and exponent alpha, and the union over standard k of WF(omega to the omega_k) is the axiom system considered in this section; the article uses these notations throughout, for instance in its introduction.
standard_prerequisites.use: They are the theories appearing in the hypothesis and the conclusion of the counted theorem, and in the assumption of its proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: Compactness and omega-extensions of topped models
standard_prerequisites.statement: The proof extends the language by a constant, uses that a theory is finitely satisfiable to obtain a model by compactness, and iterates omega-extensions of countable topped models; these are standard tools of the article, used the same way in the earlier conservation theorem of the paper.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof obtains a model with a non-standard constant by compactness and then builds an increasing sequence of omega-extensions whose union satisfies the theory together with a counterexample.

standard_prerequisites.name: Pi^1_1 conservativity
standard_prerequisites.statement: A problem is Pi^1_1 conservative over a theory when every arithmetical sentence provable in the theory together with the problem is already provable in the theory; the proof argues by contraposition on arithmetical sentences.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted theorem asserts conservativity of a Pi^1_2 problem, and the proof establishes it by refuting provability of an arithmetical sentence.

core_obligations: Argue by contraposition: assume the theory with the union of the well-foundedness statements does not prove an arithmetical sentence, and set out to build a model of the theory together with the problem and a counterexample (source line 1431).

Extend the language by a first-order constant c and use finite satisfiability plus compactness to get a model of the theory together with WF of omega_c, the statements that c exceeds every standard integer, and a counterexample; the constant c is then non-standard (source line 1433).

Invoke the hypothesis on the problem: for every countable topped model of the theory with WF of omega at the index d plus k and every instance of the problem in that model, there is a countable topped omega-extension satisfying the same theory with WF of omega at the index d alone and containing a solution of that instance (source line 1435).

Iterate that step to build an increasing sequence of countable topped models indexed by the standard integers such that the s-th model satisfies WF of omega at the index c minus k times s, and such that every instance of the problem appearing in any model of the sequence eventually has a solution in a later one (source line 1437).

Use that c is non-standard while every index s is standard to conclude that each model of the sequence satisfies the union over standard k of the well-foundedness statements, so that the union of the sequence satisfies the theory together with the problem and a counterexample, which refutes provability and gives the conservativity claimed by the counted theorem (source lines 1437-1439).

proof_roadmap.step: By contraposition, add a non-standard constant and apply compactness to get a model with a counterexample.
Restate the hypothesis on the problem as an omega-extension step that lowers the index of the well-foundedness statement.
Iterate along the standard integers, check that each model satisfies the union of the well-foundedness statements, and conclude.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Theorem theorem:problem-wf-cons-2（源 1425-1428 行，证明 1430-1440 行）：若一个 Π¹₂ 问题在每个满足 WF(ω_k^α) 的可数 topped 模型上都能求解且保持 WF(α)，则该问题对 ⊔_k WF(ω_k) 也是 Π¹₁-保守的。关键操作不是例行核验：证明走反证／紧致性——先加一个非标准常数 c 得到满足 WF(ω_c) 与「c 超过每个标准整数」的模型（1431-1433 行），再把假设重述成一步 ω-扩张把下标从 d+k 降到 d（1435 行），然后沿标准整数迭代构造递增模型链，使第 s 个模型满足 WF(ω_{c−ks})，并安排每个问题实例最终在某层被求解（1437 行）；最后靠「c 非标准、s 标准」论证每个模型都满足 ⊔_k WF(ω_k)，由并模型的相对化收尾（1437-1439 行）。难点在于把「逐层降低下标」与「问题实例最终被满足」两件事同时安排进同一条迭代链；原文位置在证明的 1433、1435 与 1437 行。
